Between June 3, 2026 and June 4, 2026, some customers experienced two related issues affecting in-app guides on the Pendo platform (pendo.io environment):

Guide Targeting Disruption: Guides that used negated, nested segment rules ("Segment is not equal to...") were incorrectly evaluated due to a segment flag processing bug. Affected guides may have failed to display to intended audiences during this window.

Conversational AI Guide Editor Unavailable: The Conversational AI interface within the guide editor ("Edit in Pendo") was inaccessible.

Guide functionality and deliverability have been fully restored. All guides that were temporarily moved to a Draft state have now been returned to their previous status.

We believe Resource Center Guide Modules were not impacted in Production or Staging environments. An issue impacting the ability to edit some guides within RC Guide Modules while in Draft state was identified and is being addressed separately.

Some guides may appear to still be in a Draft state due to browser caching. Logging out and back into Pendo will refresh the UI and reflect the correct guide status.

This incident is now resolved.
